subject: FinHealth - Security & Private/VPC deployment discovery
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@finhealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: FinHealth - Security & Private/VPC deployment discovery

Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we stay aligned with FinHealth's security/compliance requirements and upcoming procurement timeline.

Summary from today's discovery:
- Primary concern: network isolation and data residency for PHI (HIPAA applicability) and customer PII.
- Interested in Redwood Private (VPC) with optional on-prem integration; looking for air-gapped options for certain workloads.
- Need SOC 2 Type II evidence and answers to a standard vendor security questionnaire (we offered to start the questionnaire).
- Timeline: procurement evaluation window ~Apr 15; technical deep-dive requested by security team next week.

Proposed next steps:
1) I'll share a short SOC 2 summary and a vendor security questionnaire template you can review — sending both attached.
2) Can we schedule a technical deep-dive with your security/infra team next Tue or Wed (Mar 17/18)? Please share preferred times.
3) I'll prepare a deployment diagram showing VPC-only and air-gapped options and circulate it with Lauren for TLS/KMS notes.

Attachments: SOC2_Type2_summary.pdf (summary), vendor_security_questionnaire.xlsx (pre-filled starter), Redwood_Private_deployment-diagram.png (draft will follow)

If that sounds right, I'll book the deep-dive and loop in our infra lead (Lauren).

Best,
Marcus
Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference
From: Samir Patel <sec-ops@finhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@finhealth.com>, procurement@finhealth.com
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinHealth - Security & Private/VPC deployment discovery

Marcus —

Thanks for the recap and the attachments. A few quick clarifying questions from our security team:

1) SOC 2: Do you have a current Type II report we can review, or only a summary? We may need the full report under NDA during procurement.
2) Key management: Do you support customer-managed keys (BYOK) in the Private deployment? KMS/HSM integrations?
3) Network isolation: For the VPC option, does Redwood support tenant-only subnets with no shared control-plane traffic? We need explicit guarantees about data plane isolation.
4) Air-gap: For our high-risk workloads, we need an air-gapped packaging option. Do you have an on-prem bundle that can be installed without outbound connectivity? What are the limitations (updates, telemetry)?

Also, can you share an example deployment diagram with annotated traffic flows and egress controls? That will speed up our internal approval.

Best,
Samir Patel
Security Operations Manager
FinHealth
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <sec-ops@finhealth.com>
Cc: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@finhealth.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 13:52:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinHealth - Security & Private/VPC deployment discovery

Samir —

Appreciate the clear questions. Answers below (high-level; we'll provide more detail in the technical deep-dive and the deployment diagram):

1) SOC 2: We can provide the full SOC 2 Type II report under NDA. Attached is the summary for now; I'll loop in our legal team to send an NDA and the full report.
2) Key management: Yes — customer-managed keys are supported in Redwood Private. We integrate with major KMS providers and offer HSM-backed options for on-prem. We'll include specific KMS plugins and supported algorithms in the deep-dive.
3) Network isolation: For Private/VPC deployments we support tenant-isolated VPCs. Control-plane traffic can be configured to route over a customer-managed control channel; data plane remains isolated in customer subnets. I'll annotate the diagram with control-plane routing options and the available network ACLs.
4) Air-gap/on-prem: We do offer an air-gapped on-prem bundle that can be installed without outbound internet. Limitations: automated updates require a managed sync mechanism (e.g., update image via secure transfer), and telemetry is opt-out by default. We'll document patch/update procedures and support SLAs for air-gapped installs.

Next steps from our side:
- I'll circulate a pair of deployment diagrams: VPC-only (cloud-hosted Private) and air-gapped on-prem bundle (with egress controls) by EOD tomorrow.
- Please pick a 60–90 min slot for the deep-dive. Proposed windows: Tue Mar 17 09:00–11:00 PT or Wed Mar 18 13:00–15:00 PT.
- We'll include Lauren (infra lead) and Rachel (compliance) on the call to address KMS and legal questions.

If helpful, here's a quick link to our architecture folder and the HubSpot record:
- https://drive.google.com/redwood/finhealth-architecture
- https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890

Thanks — talk soon.

Regards,
Marcus
Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference
From: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@finhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <sec-ops@finhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinHealth - Security & Private/VPC deployment discovery

Marcus,

This is great — thanks for the prompt answers. We confirm we'll review the SOC2 summary over the next day and sign an NDA for the full report. Wed Mar 18 13:00 PT works best for our team for the deep-dive. We'll send a calendar invite.

Also: procurement asked for an initial redline window and expected commercial terms; I'll loop procurement once we have the technical sign-off.

Best,
Olivia
Director, IT Procurement
FinHealth
